fact: On 3 June 2025 the Prime Minister chaired the ministerial committee charged with following up Sirage, heard the Minister of Education's presentation on its progress, and ordered the sectors concerned to overcome the obstacles so that the system's benefits are obtained before the end of the current school year, with daily follow-up of the work.
title: Réunion du Comité ministériel chargé du suivi du système Sirage de gestion du secteur de l'éducation
